add.title: merge.mjs: don't union-merge a regenerated fixture .jsonl; take the branch's copy when the branch rewrote the file
add.why: chat-model step 4 (2026-11-02): ext/Chat/list/fixture/session.jsonl was regenerated on the branch (32 lines); the jsonl union KEPT the 29 old lines after it, so the demo held two sessions. Fixed by hand in 6f3d8bf11. A file the branch rewrote from line 1 is not an append log.

add.title: Files.move.test.mjs flakes inside merge.mjs's parallel smoke: it walks the whole tree and meets other tests' temp files (ENOENT on ext/Chat/v2/fixture/live-v2-*.jsonl) or a Windows lock (EPERM on undo)
add.why: chat-model steps 5+6 merge, 2026-11-02: refused once (ENOENT/EPERM), timed out the second time (150 s), passes alone (110 checks). Either run it serially, or scope its fixture dir so it never scans siblings' temp files.
